ModMetaData.name: BlueArchive-NewWorld Mac Fix
ModMetaData.author: Kevin-66
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial macOS compatibility patch for BlueArchive-NewWorld.
- Loads student and Sensei textures from banw_pawns_win at runtime on macOS. - Normalizes Windows backslash file paths for gacha videos, portraits, and voice lines at runtime. - Replaces DirectX-only shaders (drawn magenta on Metal) with Mac-supported ones at runtime. - Stops "Animation not found" exceptions from Spine characters. - Suppresses the non-NVIDIA GPU startup warning popup on macOS. - Removes an Anomaly-only stat when Anomaly is not active (red startup error).
